meta: A written review of your Android app covering crashes, speed, screen sizes and Play policy. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Android app audit with a clear priority list
overview: We install your app on phones of different sizes and use it like a new customer. We look at crashes, slow screens, battery use, accessibility, Google Play policy and the way flows connect, and read your code if you share it. You get a report with each issue, why it matters and what to do about it, ranked by priority, plus a call to go through it.

faq: Can you audit without my code?
Yes. Basic and Standard work from an installable build, such as a Play testing link or an APK. Premium includes a code review and needs read-only repository access.
Will you fix what you find?
The audit gives you the list and the plan. Fixes can be ordered through our Android feature work or maintenance services, and Premium includes priced options so you can choose.
Do you check Play policy risks?
We check against Google Play's published policies, covering permissions, data safety, billing, ads and metadata. Google decides on every app, so we flag likely problems rather than promise approval.
Can you audit an unreleased app?
Yes. Send an internal testing link or an APK and we review it the same way. Early reviews let you fix problems before testers or Google see them.
